frames.title: 1  Glue the two deck keys into the base
frames.caption:
Print the base and two Cubware deck keys. Superglue each key's
triangular nub into its 2.1 mm pocket under the base.

frames.title: 2  Press in eight M3 heat-set inserts
frames.caption:
M3 x 5.7 mm brass inserts, with a soldering iron:
four in the fan posts, four in the corner posts.

frames.title: 3  Drop in the XIAO RP2040 and the fan driver
frames.caption:
Low-side IRLZ44N with a 1N5819 flyback diode, as on the Pioreactor HAT.
USB-C sits in the wall notch; the fan above keeps the board down.

frames.title: 4  Seat the fan, rotor side up
frames.caption:
Orion OD4010-12HSS, the Pioreactor's 40 x 40 x 10.5 mm 2-wire fan,
on the four posts with its leads toward the MOSFET.

frames.title: 5  Four M3 x 16 screws through the fan
frames.caption:
Into the post inserts. Snug only: the fan frame is plastic.
Use stainless screws near the magnets.

frames.title: 6  Magnets into the carrier, carrier onto the hub
frames.caption:
Two 1/4 x 1/16 in N52 discs, 9.8 mm apart as on the Pioreactor:
red = north up, blue = south up. CA glue; centre the carrier on the hub.

frames.title: 7  Glue in the Hall sensor, lower the vial holder
frames.caption:
US1881 latch on the pocket ceiling beside the magnets, leads down a groove
to the XIAO: one pulse per turn. The carrier turns under a 1.2 mm floor.

frames.title: 8  Four M3 x 12 screws through the flange
frames.caption: Into the corner-post inserts.

frames.title: 9  Set the module on the CubXL deck
frames.caption:
The keys drop into two adjacent slots, 25 mm apart: a slip fit held by gravity,
like Cubware's holders. The vial axis sits midway between the two slot columns.

frames.title: 10  Stir bar into the vial, vial into the holder
frames.caption:
15 x 6 mm PTFE bar. Three crush ribs in the bore grip the 28 mm vial
so the capper can twist the cap.

frames.title: Assembled
frames.caption:
56 x 56 mm footprint, 50 mm tall without the vial. The vial's bottom sits
25 mm above the deck and its rim ~82 mm.

frames.title: Exploded view
frames.caption:
Printed: base, vial holder, magnet carrier, 2 deck keys.
Bought: fan, XIAO, MOSFET, diode, Hall latch, magnets, stir bar, M3 hardware.

frames.title: Section through the vial axis
frames.caption:
Magnet faces to the vial's outside bottom: ~1.2 mm air + 1.2 mm print = 2.4 mm
(Pioreactor v1.5: ~7 mm). Hall latch at left, MOSFET and diode at right.
